- **n36 `[b,r,g,s]`** — `+n37, +n41, +n42, +n43, +n48`. Additional coordination: `S:633–636 UI` shares `io.terminal` with the renderer; `T:34–66 D, 308–352 UI, 702–762 DUI` owns the terminal, installs the parser/handler, and coordinates rendering, interpretation, and reply notification; `src/renderer/generic.zig:1420–1427,1479–1493 UI` consumes the same terminal under the shared lock.
- **n37 `[st,e,b,r,s]`** — `+n38, +n39, +n40`. `src/termio.zig:23–29 D`; `S:687–701,711–721,761–767 UI`; `IT:136–138,253–278 UI`; `T:34–35 D,308–310,335–349,367–371,389–400,427–429 UI,354–365 DUI`; `B:13–54,76–86 DUI`; `X:1–4,44–45,568–609 D,49–84,86–230,274–315,403–490,887–893,1105–1133 DUI,493–538 D`; `src/pty.zig:189–192,457–464 DI`. These cover selection of Exec, subprocess and PTY ownership, read/write setup and dispatch, exit notification, and cleanup.
- **n38 `[e,b,r]`** — `S:651–659,687–701 UI`; `X:49–57 DUI,86–104 UI,568–569,587–609 D,624–629 D,763–883 UI,895–1103 DUI,1844–2026 DUI`; `src/pty.zig:19–23 D,69–72,133–187,228–266,343–455 DUI`; `src/Command.zig:160–483 DUI`; `src/os/flatpak.zig:118–139,280–312,319–447 DUI`. Includes configuration-to-argv, POSIX PTY/stdio/fork/exec, Windows ConPTY/CreateProcess, and Flatpak host-spawn branches. The iOS selection is a `NullPty` stub, not an actual PTY open.
- **n39 `[st,e,b,r,g,s]`** — `X:139–156 UI,1269–1776 DUI`; `T:702–716,736–754 DUI`; `RS:82–105 DI`. POSIX selection, fixed four-slot ring of 64 KiB buffers, gather `read`/`poll`, publication, FIFO consumption via `processOutput`, slot return/backpressure, and renderer handoff between batches.
- **n40 `[e,b,r,g]`** — `X:139–156,1083–1094 UI,206–229 I,1778–1826 DUI`; `src/pty.zig:19–23 D,419–425,439–455 I`; `T:702–711 DI`; `RS:82–105 DI`. Windows selects the ConPTY output pipe and runs `ReadFile` and `processOutput` serially on one reader; cancellation interrupts its blocking read for shutdown.
- **n41 `[e,b,g]`** — `RS:13–20 D`; `T:45–46 D,702–762 DUI`; `H:138–186 DUI`; `src/termio/mailbox.zig:57–98 DUI`. `processOutput` acquires and defers release of the lock around interpretation. Mailbox backpressure paths can release and reacquire it before parsing resumes.
- **n42 `[st,e,b,r]`** — `T:64–66 D,312–328,335–351 UI,714,736–754 UI`; `H:96 D,188–206 DUI`; `src/terminal/main.zig:60–64 D`; `VS:557–604 D,636–665 DI,719–739,831–1671 DUI,1673,1852–1875,2960,2983–2998 UI`; `src/terminal/Parser.zig:254–410 DUI`. Covers construction, slice/scalar input, printable runs, parser-state dispatch and representative CSI/OSC delivery. The inspector path uses `next(byte)` instead of `nextSlice`.
- **n43 `[e,b,r,s]`** — `+n44, +n45, +n46, +n47`; `T:14 U,308–352 UI,354–365 UI,702–762 DUI`; `VS:719–739,1547–1593 UI`; include **n49** as the outbound UI handoff. The handler’s action switch and helpers bridge terminal mutations, stateful protocol processing, and all three destinations: I/O, renderer, and app.
- **n44 `[e]`** — `H:19–1958 DUI,1960–1975 DI`. The first range is the complete production `StreamHandler` definition; the second is its OSC 7 helper. No in-file tests included.
- **n45 `[st,b,r,g]`** — `T:40–46 D,312–328,335–351 UI,360–361 U`; `H:19–26,62–112 D I,188–304,319–553,641,675–748,938–953,1000–1035,1080–1134,1235–1481,1483–1517,1619–1742,1862–1869,1897–1936 DUI`; `VS:1036–1044,1076–1119,1297–1329,1577–1593 UI`; `src/terminal/apc.zig:11–249 DUI`; `src/terminal/dcs.zig:11–205 DUI`; `src/terminal/kitty/clipboard.zig:62–65 D`; `VT:608–725 DUI,1893 D,2207–2298,2301–2314,2401–2449 UI,3235–3281,4664–4687,5618–5631 DUI`; `src/terminal/Screen.zig:840–859,913–931 DUI`. Covers actual grid/cursor and session mutations plus retained APC, DCS, tmux and Kitty clipboard transaction state.
- **n46 `[b,r,s]`** — `VS:1660,1673,2172–2194,2385–2412 UI`; `H:28–29,87–90 D,151–154 DUI,248,305–306,326–332,353–354 UI,475–482,496–553,602–639,750–773,829–911,925–928,965–995,1454–1472,1619–1624,1749–1839,1851–1952 DUI`; `src/termio/message.zig:13–32,51–54,91–98 D,107–116 DI`; `T:312–328 UI,437–463 DUI,567–593 DUI,682–700 DUI,756–762 UI,778–822 DUI`; `src/termio/mailbox.zig:15–18,30–34 D,57–108 DUI`; `IT:253–278 UI,289–375,453–471 DUI`; `B:76–86 DUI`; `X:129–131,147–155 UI,403–490 DUI,493–525 D,1083–1094 UI`. Direct replies enqueue write variants; size/color/visibility reports can enqueue a request that the I/O thread encodes before writing. Title-query detour: `H:1852–1860` → **n49/n50** handoff → `S:1039–1062,899–920 DUI` → `T:437–447`.
- **n47 `[e,b,r]`** — `S:718 U`; `T:319 U,714–716 UI`; `H:40–42 D,114–119 DUI,516–553 UI`; `RT:37–40 D,127–129,151–163 I,231–234 U,474–517,537–586 DUI`; `src/renderer/generic.zig:1420–1427,1479–1487 UI`. Notification can be sent before parsing because the renderer must acquire the same mutex before reading the terminal. Wakeup schedules work; it does not guarantee immediate presentation.
- **n48 `[b,r,g,s]`** — `+n49, +n50, +n51`. `H:236,328,358–384 U,555–557,1000–1077,1136,1193–1219,1388–1438,1483–1517,1519,1526–1539,1599–1617,1619–1742,1841–1849,1954–1957 DUI`; `VS:1654–1667,2960,2983–2998,3009–3020,3037–3055 UI`; `AM:13–74 D`; `S:6612–6656 DUI`. Native boundary: `src/apprt.zig:39–53 D`; `src/apprt/embedded.zig:269–271,303–342,1730–1736 DUI`; `src/apprt/gtk/App.zig:56–68 DUI`; `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:569–576,692,775–789,1322–1325,2994–3002 UI`; `macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:58–62 U,119–122,526–534,639–644,1807–1825 UI`. The macOS wakeup callback explicitly schedules the tick on the main queue; GTK wakes its GLib loop.
- **n49 `[st,b,r]`** — `S:573,711–721 UI`; `T:55–56 D,312–322,335–342 UI`; `H:28–35 D,138–149 DUI`; `AM:186–207 DUI`; `A:49–51,577–581 D,596–613 DUI`. The surface mailbox wraps the destination pointer and payload in `App.Message.surface_message`, pushes into the app’s queue, and wakes the runtime.
- **n50 `[e,b,r]`** — `A:161–167,272–306,531–542 DUI`; `S:1015–1241 DUI`; `src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:569–576 U`; `src/apprt/embedded.zig:1730–1736 U`.
- **n51 `[b,r,g]`** — `A:28 D,202–206,222–241,293,531–550 UI`. The dispatch guard scans the registered runtime surfaces for a matching core pointer and drops the message if none matches. This is a registration check, not a generation-ID check.
